title: L-shaped room area
observableEvidence: Finds the area of an L-shaped composite figure by splitting it into two rectangles and inferring a hidden side length.
prompt: An L-shaped room is formed by a 10-by-6-meter rectangle with a 4-by-3-meter rectangular corner removed from one corner. What is the area of the L-shaped room, in square meters?
solutionRepresentation: Full rectangle area = 10 × 6 = 60. Removed corner area = 4 × 3 = 12. L-shaped area = 60 − 12 = 48 square meters.
solutionMethod: Find the area of the full rectangle before the corner is removed, find the area of the removed corner rectangle, then subtract.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept with or without the unit.

hintSteps.prompt: Picture the L-shape as a full rectangle with a smaller rectangle cut out of one corner.
hintSteps.question: What is the area of the full 10-by-6 rectangle before anything is removed?

hintSteps.prompt: The removed corner is its own rectangle with its own dimensions.
hintSteps.question: What is the area of the 4-by-3 corner that was removed?

hintSteps.prompt: This is like cutting a bite-sized rectangle out of the corner of a rectangular sheet of paper and finding how much paper is left.
hintSteps.question: What do you get when you subtract the removed corner's area from the full rectangle's area?
